purpose: Compare inventory compositions while keeping the approved C Floating Dock and shared Khonnai theme
approvedNavigation: C Floating Dock on desktop and mobile

options.name: Compact Cards
options.description: Horizontal photo/code cards; two desktop columns and one mobile column
options.strength: Scan product codes and reach one full-width touch target
options.tradeoff: Less product imagery visible than a photo gallery

options.name: Quiet Gallery
options.correction: Unique desktop code sequence and one combined stock action per variant
options.description: Borderless square photo gallery with clear code footers; three desktop columns and two mobile columns
options.strength: Recognize products visually while retaining the explicit code-size-color flow
options.tradeoff: More vertical space per item; a no-photo fallback needs equal care

options.name: Split Workspace
options.description: Desktop product-code list beside selected details; mobile retains separate list and detail screens
options.strength: Keep browsing context visible while opening another product on a wide screen
options.tradeoff: Requires sufficient desktop width; draft changes still require the existing unsaved guard
